name: showSignInResult
description: Report the outcome of a sign-in whose redirect a window opened with awaitSignInResult has captured. ok: the window shows the host's 'You're signed in' page, closes itself 1.5 s later and fires onClosed { windowId, reason: 'api' }. Not ok: the window shows the host's 'Couldn't sign in' page with `message` (whitespace collapsed, cut to 300 characters, shown as plain text) and stays open until the person or close closes it. At most once per capture; invalid_args when the window has no captured sign-in waiting. The pages are in the browser's UI language; `message` is shown as given. Manifest primitive webWindow.signInResult. Returns { ok: true }.

inputs.name: windowId
inputs.description: A window this connection opened with awaitSignInResult, after its onRedirectCaptured.

inputs.name: message
inputs.description: Not ok only: the failure reason to show, e.g. the server's error. Absent: no reason line.
